details.text: A Mission for our Young Plant Detectives and Adults!

items.text: Kitchen or Pharmacy? Take a deep breath! Does it smell like a giant outdoor kitchen or a village pharmacy? Actually, it’s both!
The Ultimate Survival Kit: Before modern medicine and supermarkets, these gardens were an island survival kit. These plots are filled with the exact same herbs that have grown here for centuries.

Nature's Doctor: Herbs like Thyme, Oregano, and Marjoram weren’t just used to make dinner taste amazing they were the local doctor! If someone had a stomach ache, the wind miller’s family wouldn't run to the pharmacy for bad-tasting pink syrup they would come right here to pick leaves for a natural remedy.
A Painter's Palette: Check out the beautiful purple Lavender and bright green Mint! They look like someone painted them right into the garden. Pay close attention to those bright colors!
Old-School Fun: Put the phones away for a second we are going completely old-school! Do you see the physical puzzle pieces scattered around?
Use Your Senses: Your job is to figure out which word belongs to which plant. You will have to use your eyes and your nose!
Rub and Sniff: Go ahead, give the leaves a tiny, gentle rub and a sniff (but please, no grazing don't eat the garden before lunch!).

Solve the Puzzle: Can you move the puzzle pieces to match the correct herbs? See if you can figure out the difference between the Mint and the Oregano. Which one smells like a delicious pizza, and which one smells like a cozy nap?
Sketchbook Reminder: Keep your eyes open, Plant Detectives! Remember the different colors of green, grey, and purple to color your Mylotopi Sketch later.
Upcoming: Then move forward to the Historic Windmill!
